import FreeCAD as App, Part, Sketcher
V = App.Vector
doc = App.ActiveDocument
sk = doc.getObject("Sketch")
sk.deleteAllGeometry()
pts = [(0,0),(40,0),(40,13),(35,13),(35,8),(8,8),(8,60),(0,60)]
n = len(pts)
for i in range(n):
    a, b = pts[i], pts[(i+1) % n]
    sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(V(a[0],a[1],0), V(b[0],b[1],0)))
for i in range(n):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", i, 2, (i+1) % n, 1))
doc.recompute()
pad = doc.getObject("Pad")
print("valid:", pad.Shape.isValid(), "vol:", pad.Shape.Volume, pad.Length.Value)
print("bbox:", pad.Shape.BoundBox)
